items.title: Flank, flip, or pass: how I coded Reversi in 124 lines for a multiplayer browser game
items.description: Reversi is one of those games you can explain in a sentence and still lose to for years. Place a disc so that it traps a straight line of your opponent's discs between it and another of yours, and every trapped disc flips to your colour. Whoever owns the most discs when nobody can move wins.
